'''Carter Escalon''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]]. While carrying intelligence data from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Escalon was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. The Imperials did not find the stolen data, because Escalon stored it in a [[Swift 78B Vessel Courier System]], but did sentence him to a [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Sevarcos II]]. Escalon was rescued by an [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team aided by the [[Sevari]] nomad [[Jax Seldam]].<ref name="FHW" />
